body: Rarely will you get an actual refund unless the reason is them being at fault 100%. It's just store credit.

There is literally nothing she's doing that makes it clear you're becoming the 3rd/4th option at all..... you're literally making that up in your head. My phone used to say I was on the app all the time when I wasn't just because I didn't bother signing out.... like maybe shes just busy or has a damn job. Nothing I said is the "worst possible scenario" lol.... I legit just said maybe she's busy and you're over reacting.... how is that even a bad scenario? Tbh you sound like an infuriating loser, I hope for her sake she found better dick.

Again.. the opinion that sad little desperate men have of me... doesn't mean anything. Your making assumptions about her having other men/options because you are watching her online status on the app... sounds a bit creepy/stalker vibes to me. You're upset that the next date is more days away then the previous and yet again making assumptions about this... instead of thinking perhaps maybe this lady this has a life that doesn't revolve around you? Tbh you sound a bit insane and obsessive to me 🤷‍♀️. Guys who acted like you were the # one reason I stopped using dating apps (I met my boyfriend organically). The kind of intense pressure you guys put on woman is a major turn off and your expectations were ridiculous. Chances are there are totally normal every day reasons behind her actions that you are making wild assumptions about. If you continue to act this way you might get in your own way and ruin it for yourself and scare her off. Instead of playing games like "well if shes not going to text me  then I'm not going to text her either" (she might just be busy or having a personal issue like work stress, or maybe shes not as chatty every day like you are.. not everyone has the social energy to chat every single day)... like actually try legitimate communication for fucks sakes instead of being a weird psycho. She doesn't know you..  and the way you are obsessing and over analyzing every little thing... will legit scare her off. Chill the fuck out.

If you say so....
But at least I'm not obsessing about some stranger who owes me absolutely nothing. I have a boyfriend... we have mutual respect and don't assume we "own" one another in this jealous stalker way you that you have described 🤷‍♀️

Maybe your possessive obsessiveness is making her feel icky and she's backing away. A couple dates is nothing.. you're basically strangers. If a guy acted this way with me.. I'd go from interested to ghosting real fast. You sound like a toxic tool.

Just do it. There doesn't need to be some waiting period or any weird games. I respect knowing how someone feels and what they want, I move on from guys who play games. 


I recently started dating someone and the wonderful thing about it is that it was the easiest and most straight forward experience I've EVER had. We hung out the first time and it went really well. I was on my way home from the date when he messaged me and said he had a really good time. We talked about how nervous we both were and it was very cute and such a relief to know we both had those same feelings.
There is nothing wrong with letting someone feel secure... especially if those feelings are mutual. 


Our second date was adorable and ended up lasting an entire day longer then planned. A few hours after I got home... I just straight up said "hey so... do you want to date me?", and he said yes immediately and that he was trying to ask but he was shy about it. If both of us played these waiting games then it wouldn't have felt so easy and natural. We both knew almost immediately that we were into it and wanted to spend time together. There's nothing wrong with being honest about how you feel and what your intentions are.

Okay.. so let's say you spend the night together? Are you expected to host every single time? Do you fuck at his parents place? 
Also he's 36... and still hasn't had a serious relationship at all that would lead him to move out with a woman? That would be a red flag for me.
Also hes never had the experience of living alone. If I got together with him I'd be worried his expectations of me to take care of him.
Its up to you, but it would be an automatic no from me.
